Mind & preparation

Pre-shot routine, attention, breathing, cue words, imagery, nerves, pressure, resetting after a miss, goals, competition day, anti-doping, juniors.

12 lessons≈ 58 min

Before the shot

  1. Pre-shot routine: the same steps in the same order
    6 min★ Start hereSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionInterpreterNew coach

    A short pre-shot routine helps you shoot the same way in training and in competition: six steps that fit the time limits of Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting.

  2. Eyes and attention: soft focus, hard focus and the quiet eye
    5 min▶ with animationSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionNew coach

    How to switch your attention on for the few seconds of each target and off between stands, and what your eyes do: soft focus, hard focus and the quiet eye.

  3. Breathing: what to do and when
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competition

    Slow breathing calms the body, but timing matters. What you can try on training days, before the stand, at the call and after a miss.

  4. Cue words and self-talk
    4 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionInterpreterNew coach

    Short cue words about the target can help more than slogans. How to choose two or three with your coach, and why “don't” cues can backfire.

  5. Imagery: rehearse the stand
    5 min▶ with animationSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionNew coach

    How to run each target through in your head after the presentation: through your own eyes, at the speed of the real shot, once or twice per target.

Under pressure

  1. Reset after a miss
    4 min★ Start hereSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionInterpreterParents of a juniorNew coach

    A short routine for the seconds after a lost target: five steps in 5–10 seconds, then the next target. The “why” waits until after the round.

  2. Nerves and your own zone
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionParents of a junior

    Nerves before a competition are normal. How to find the level that suits you, read a racing heart as readiness, and know when to ask for help.

  3. Pressure and choking: why easy targets get missed
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionNew coach

    Under pressure, skilled shooters sometimes start steering a shot they usually make without thinking. How to spot the signs and what can help.

  4. Process goals and the score
    4 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionNew coach

    Why goals about what you do tend to help more than goals about winning, and how to set goals for your first competition.

Competition day

  1. Competition day: sleep, coffee, water and food
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionOrganiser

    How to keep your energy over a long competition day: your usual bedtime, your usual coffee, water little and often, familiar food and no alcohol.

  2. Medicines and anti-doping: beta-blockers, TUE, supplements
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingFirst competitionOrganiser

    The WADA list bans beta-blockers at all times in Olympic and para shooting (ISSF, IPC); treat them as prohibited in Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting too. How to check a medicine, when you need a TUE, and what to know about supplements, CBD and alcohol.

Juniors

  1. Juniors and parents: support without pressure
    5 minSporting™Compak® SportingParents of a juniorNew coach

    The coach teaches, the parent supports. Praise effort and the routine rather than the score, let the child start the talk afterwards, and stay quiet behind the stand.
